sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: Trapping a ball with the sole of your foot means:
options: A) Kicking it with your toes
B) Placing the bottom of your foot lightly on top of the ball to stop it
C) Jumping on the ball with both feet
D) Hitting it with your knee
questions.answer: B) Placing the bottom of your foot lightly on top of the ball to stop it

questions.question_text: In Gilli-Danda, fielding players try to do what after the Gilli is struck?
options: B) Catch it in the air to get the striker out
C) Kick it over the fence
questions.answer: B) Catch it in the air to get the striker out

questions.question_text: Bhujangasana mimics the posture of which animal?
What is the most important way the body recovers after a full day of playing and learning?
options: C) Getting a good night's sleep
questions.answer: C) Getting a good night's sleep

questions.question_text: The force of striking a ball determines:
options: A) What color the ball is
B) How far and fast the ball will travel
C) Who the ball belongs to
D) The shape of the ball
questions.answer: B) How far and fast the ball will travel

questions.question_text: When jumping for maximum height, you should use your arms to:
options: A) Swing upward to help lift your body
B) Hold them tightly by your sides
questions.answer: A) Swing upward to help lift your body

questions.question_text: In Kho-Kho, occasionally a chaser will dive near the pole. This is done to:
options: B) Tag a runner who is just out of reach
questions.answer: B) Tag a runner who is just out of reach

questions.question_text: A good environment for practicing Yoga Sadhana is:
options: C) A quiet, clean, and well-ventilated space
questions.answer: C) A quiet, clean, and well-ventilated space

questions.question_text: Shaking hands with opponents after a match is a sign of:
If a player bumps their head and gets a swelling, applying ice helps to:
options: B) Reduce the swelling and pain
questions.answer: B) Reduce the swelling and pain

questions.question_text: Explain how to trap a rolling ball with the sole of your foot safely.
questions.answer: Wait for the ball to come close, lift your foot slightly, and gently press the bottom (sole) of your foot down on the top of the ball to stop it without stomping hard.

questions.question_text: What happens in Gilli-Danda if a fielder catches the Gilli in the air?
questions.answer: If a fielder catches the Gilli in the air before it touches the ground, the striker is declared 'out'.

questions.question_text: Why is getting enough sleep important for young athletes?
questions.answer: Sleep gives the body time to rest, repair muscles, and build energy so we are strong and focused for the next day's activities.

questions.question_text: What do your knees do when you land from a high jump?
questions.answer: Your knees must bend when you land to act like springs, absorbing the shock so you don't hurt your legs or back.

questions.question_text: Why do we apply ice to a bumped knee or elbow?
questions.answer: Ice cools the injured area, which helps numb the pain and stops the bump from swelling too much.

sections.section_name: Section C - Sports Mechanics & Fill in the Blanks

questions.question_text: Fill in the blanks regarding Rest and Recovery (Sleep, Stretch, Water): 1. Drink plenty of _____ after a sweaty game. 2. _____ your legs gently if they feel tight. 3. Get at least 9 hours of _____ every night.
Match the Yoga pose (Asana) to its English name based on nature/animals: 1. Bhujangasana, 2. Tadasana, 3. Vrikshasana. (Names: Mountain Pose, Cobra Pose, Tree Pose).
questions.answer: 1. Bhujangasana = Cobra Pose. 2. Tadasana = Mountain Pose. 3. Vrikshasana = Tree Pose.

questions.question_text: Your team just won the championship game. The other team is very sad and some players are crying. How can you celebrate your win while showing humility and grace?
questions.answer: I should celebrate quietly with my team first, then walk over to the other team, shake their hands, and tell them they played a really great game. I should not boast or tease them about losing.

questions.question_text: Plan a full-body stretching sequence using 3 simple movements to do after a game of football.
questions.answer: Step 1: Sit on the ground with legs straight and reach for your toes to stretch the hamstrings. Step 2: Stand up and pull one heel gently towards your back to stretch the front thigh (quadriceps). Step 3: Reach both arms high over your head and lean side-to-side to stretch the sides and back.
